summary: Burst speed with body size exists in small Dryad tables (Great Basin stream fishes; burst-tunnel trials) and as species-level literature rows in FishBase's Speed table; prolonged (Ucrit) performance with body length is compiled for 1,345 cases / 361 species in a CC BY 4.0 Zenodo synthesis. No open dataset pairs these with time-to-fatigue curves or annual distance travelled for the same size series; Movebank's API requires an account.
next_step: Use the Zenodo Ucrit synthesis plus FishBase burst rows for the speed-vs-length exponents, obtain fatigue-curve data (Brett-style endurance at fixed speed) from primary papers, and request fish studies from Movebank with an account for annual distance; then pre-register the three exponent comparisons.
obstacles_confirmed: Sprint tests, fatigue curves, and annual tracks are rarely available for the same size series.
Movebank requires credentials for study listing and download.
